Merman Measurement Bake-off

Spike S2 for 2026-10-21-merman. Option A shapes labels with rustybuzz (a mirror of usvg 0.47); option B is Merman's native measurement on the same font files. Both render with Merman 482fcde, the resvg-safe pipeline, Mermaid's dark theme, and resvg 0.47 drawing from exactly those files. Images below are macOS (Trebuchet MS). is each label's measured width, drawn over the text resvg actually drew.

\n in labels

Each label holds a literal backslash-n: Alpha one\nBravo two is longer. “After rewrite” replaces it with <br/> before parsing. “Box fits widest line” compares the label's box with the same diagram drawn on one line (\n replaced by a space): the box keeps that one-line padding around the widest line. “Box keeps one-line width” is the waste Ken saw in Zed.
